Yesterday you learned to describe a dataset. Today you start interrogating one.

Day 3 owns two sentences, and between them they answer most of the questions anyone asks of a
table. The **filter sentence** keeps the rows that satisfy a condition. The **top-N sentence**
puts rows in order and takes the front of the list. Booleans, comparison operators and
`if`/`elif`/`else` arrive this morning because a filter needs them.
